summary:
The Cosmos Team developed "Project Afterglow", an immersive digital archive and storytelling platform for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

We built an interactive exhibit mapping the silent rovers, landers, and hardware left across the Moon and Mars. By blending historical blueprints, emotional narratives, and mini-games, the project transforms technical space history into a captivating experience for young explorers, ensuring our mechanical pioneers are never forgotten.
details:
• What it does: Project Afterglow is an interactive web archive mapping the rovers, landers, and equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Users can view blueprints, official NASA media links, timelines, and play space-themed mini-games.
  • Benefits: Makes space history engaging, emotional, and accessible for youth and space enthusiasts.
  • Intended Impact: Honors humanity's mechanical pioneers and ensures our silent space technology is never forgotten.
  • Tools Used: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, and SVG blueprints.
  • Creativity: Blends a high-end archival aesthetic, CRT visual filters, and interactive gamified storytelling.
  • Key Factors: Focused on smooth responsiveness, accessibility, historical accuracy, and official NASA source accreditation.
